name: Разрез объекта
about: Предмет вскрыт по одной плоскости: видно, что у него внутри и на каких уровнях. Фигуры расставлены по отсекам — по одной-две на уровень, каждая занята своим. Это способ показать предмет, а не манера рисунка: разрез применим с любым направлением стиля, и именно оно решает, чем он нарисован.

figures.where: нижний уровень, у механизма, спиной к срезу
средний уровень, за пультом, в профиль
верхний уровень, стоит у края, смотрит вниз

camera: фронтально к плоскости среза, уровень середины объекта
scene:
Scene: a large machine or structure cut open along one flat vertical plane, so that its
interior is fully visible: three stacked levels separated by plain grey decks, with plain grey
boxes standing in for equipment, tanks and stowage. On the lowest level one dark grey mannequin
stands at a machine with its back to the cut. On the middle level a mid-grey mannequin sits at a
console in profile. On the top level a lighter mannequin stands at the edge of the deck looking
down. Ladders connect the levels. Outside the cut face, the object's plain outer shell is visible
at both ends.
Composition: the cut face square to the camera and filling the frame, levels stacked, figures
small but clearly placed, thin leader lines running out to the margins.
prompt_en:
Style: a flat composition blockout, NOT an illustration and NOT a finished picture.
Featureless smooth grey mannequin figures: no faces, no hair, no clothing, no fingers, no
texture, no pattern. Plain flat mid-grey background. Environment reduced to the few plain grey
boxes and planes needed to place the figures — a table is a box, a wall is a plane, a doorway is
a rectangular hole. Even flat illumination with no cast shadows, no rim light, no atmosphere, no
depth haze. Greyscale only: no colour anywhere. No linework, no hatching, no rendering style, no
artistic flourish. This image exists solely to record where bodies are in space and how they are
turned. Each figure is a distinct flat value of grey so they can be told apart.

Avoid: colour, texture, pattern, facial features, clothing detail, dramatic lighting, cast
shadows, background scenery, mood, atmosphere, artistic style of any kind, signatures,
watermarks, any legible text, numbers or labels anywhere in the frame.
